title: My Neighborhood
text:
I live in a small neighborhood in the city. My street is quiet and green. There is a park next to my house. Many children play there after school.

There is also a small shop on the corner. The shop owner is very friendly. He sells bread, milk, and fruit. I like my neighborhood because it is safe and nice.

questions.text: How does the writer feel about the neighborhood?
options: They are afraid of their street
They do not know the shop

questions.text: What kind of person is the shop owner most likely to be?

vocabulary.definition: a small area of a town or city where people live
kind and easy to talk to

paragraph_translations: Şehirde küçük bir mahallede yaşıyorum. Sokağım sessiz ve yeşil. Evimin yanında bir park var. Okuldan sonra birçok çocuk orada oynar.
Köşede küçük bir dükkân da var. Dükkânın sahibi çok arkadaş canlısı. Ekmek, süt ve meyve satıyor. Mahallemi seviyorum çünkü güvenli ve güzel.
